theater: 重慶府城與嘉陵江兩岸

battle.name: 重慶之戰
battle.theater: 重慶府城與嘉陵江兩岸
battle.brief: 至元十二年九月，元軍進逼重慶府城，把配重投石車架在嘉陵江兩岸的灘地，向城頭與城樓逐日拋射石彈；守將王堅以城上拋石機反擊，元軍名將汪德臣中砲石重傷而死，圍城逾年而城終陷。卡面這件配重投石車是本役攻防兩端都在使用的器械。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 這場戰爭是元朝第二次大規模攻宋的川東戰線上一場以攻城工程為主的圍城戰，發生於元至元十二年至十四年（一二七五至一二七七年）。元朝一方由大汗忽必烈下詔，川東戰線由都元帥阿術與名將汪德臣、汪良臣兄弟率領，其兵力和技術力量來自三個來源：蒙古騎兵、由北方漢人組成的漢軍步兵，以及由西域來的回回砲手與隨軍工匠；此外還有大批隨軍運夫、木匠、石匠、製繩與造船的匠戶，攻城所需的一切器物都由這些人在江灘與山岡上就地造出。南宋一方由知重慶府、兼四川制置副使王堅率領守軍，副將張珏等分守城門與江面，兵員以數千計，後方則有成都、瀘州、夔州方向的援軍與糧道。襄樊在一二七三年陷落、鄂州與臨安在一二七五至一二七六年間相繼失守之後，元廷得以把主力由荊湖、江淮調向四川；重慶與合州釣魚城構成了南宋最後的山城防禦體系，元軍必須先攻破這兩點，才能打通長江上游，順流直下江南。這一戰的雙方都不是單一民族國家：元軍是由蒙古騎兵、漢軍、回回砲手與匠戶拼合成的多族部隊，南宋守軍則由四川本地禁軍、從江淮調來的援軍以及歷年募來的鄉兵組成，兩者的士氣、裝備與補給條件相差極大，而這些差異最後都落到誰能把石彈扔得更準、誰能把糧草送得更久上面。
countriesEn: This war was a siege fought largely with siege engineering on the eastern Sichuan front of the second Mongol offensive against the Song, spanning the twelfth to the fourteenth years of the Zhixuan era of the Yuan (1275 to 1277). The Yuan side acted on an order of the Great Khan Kublai Khan; the eastern Sichuan front was entrusted to the commander-in-chief Asu and to the renowned general Wang Dechen and his elder brother Wang Liangchen, and its men and technical resources came from three sources: Mongol cavalry, Han Chinese infantry drawn from the north, and Huihui trebuchet crews and craftsmen from the western regions; there were also large numbers of military porters, carpenters, stonemasons, rope-makers and boatwrights, and every implement of the siege was built by these men on the river flats and ridges outside the walls. The Song side was led by Wang Jian, governor of Chongqing prefecture and deputy regional military commissioner of Sichuan, with Zhang Jue and others holding the gates and the river; the garrison numbered several thousand men, and behind it lay the relief armies and supply lines of Chengdu, Luzhou and Kuizhou. After Xiangyang fell in 1273 and Ezhou and Lin'an were lost in succession in 1275 and 1276, the Yuan court was able to shift its main effort from Jinghu and Jianghuai to Sichuan. Chongqing and Diaoyucheng in Hezhou formed the last mountain-fortress system of the Song, and the Yuan had to break these two points before it could open the upper Yangtze and descend straight into the south. Neither side here was a single ethnic state: the Yuan army was a patchwork of Mongol cavalry, Han troops, Huihui trebuchet crews and craftsmen, while the Song garrison combined local Sichuan imperial guards, reinforcements sent down from Jianghuai and village levies raised over the years; the difference in morale, equipment and supply between them was enormous, and in the end all of that difference came down to who could throw a stone more accurately and who could keep the grain moving longer.
people: 主導全局的是元世祖忽必烈。他自即位之初便以滅宋為既定國策，一二七四年下令再攻宋，兵分三路指向荊湖、江淮與四川，川東一路交給阿術、汪德臣等人，重慶是其中最硬的一塊骨頭。汪德臣是元初名將、汪良臣之弟，統兵自西北沿四川盆地南下，攻城之際身先士卒，中砲石重傷，一二七五年秋卒於軍中，忽必烈聞訊震悼，下令厚葬追贈，其部軍務由其兄汪良臣接替，這是元軍滅宋過程中為數不多的將領折損。宋方主持者是王堅，這位此前在合州釣魚城抵擋蒙哥汗南侵的名將，入主重慶後整修城防、儲備糧草、增設砲位，把山城經營成一座真正能守、能撐、能反擊的要塞，圍城期間仍多次出城夜襲元軍營壘；一二七六年宋廷以朝廷爭議為由將他召回貶官，他死於赴闕途中。副將張珏是重慶防務中另一個不肯屈服的人，一二七七年城陷前率部出城突圍，兵敗被俘，押解大都後拒降，次年被殺，年僅四十餘。伯顏在荊湖戰線攻取鄂州、進逼臨安，與川東的圍城形成南北兩面的牽制；南宋丞相賈似道主持的鄂州和議一度讓雙方停兵，卻被宋廷推翻，成為忽必烈全面進攻的導火線。另有宋方守將趙安等在圍城戰中陣亡，細節各說互有出入，但都指向同一件事：這座城的陷落，是許多人用命換下來的。
peopleEn: The man behind the whole enterprise was the Yuan emperor Kublai Khan. From the moment of his accession he treated the destruction of the Song as settled policy, and in 1274 he ordered a new offensive against the Song with the army split three ways towards Jinghu, Jianghuai and Sichuan; the eastern Sichuan column was given to Asu, Wang Dechen and others, and Chongqing was the hardest bone in it. Wang Dechen was one of the leading generals of the early Yuan and the younger brother of Wang Liangchen; he led his men down into the Sichuan basin from the north-west, fought in the forefront of the assault, was struck by a stone from a catapult, and died of his wounds in the field in the autumn of 1275. Kublai was greatly shaken when he heard, ordered a state burial and raised the dead man's rank, and the command passed to the elder brother Wang Liangchen; this was one of the few senior losses the Yuan suffered in the conquest of the Song. On the Song side the defence was led by Wang Jian, the general who had already held Mongke Khan off at Diaoyucheng in Hezhou; once he took charge of Chongqing he repaired the walls, stored grain, added artillery positions and turned the mountain city into a fortress that could hold, endure and strike back, and he led night raids against the Yuan camp outside the walls even while the siege was on. In 1276 the Southern Song court recalled him and stripped him of his command over court factions, and he died on the road to the capital. His deputy Zhang Jue was the other man in the defence of Chongqing who would not yield: in 1277, before the city fell, he led a breakout, was beaten and captured, refused to surrender when he was brought to Dadu, and was killed the following year, still in his forties. Bayan on the Jinghu front took Ezhou and pressed on Lin'an, holding the eastern Sichuan siege in a pincer; the peace negotiated at Ezhou by the Song chancellor Jia Sidao had brought a temporary halt to the fighting, and the court overturned it, which became the pretext for Kublai's general offensive. Song commanders such as Zhao An also fell in the fighting around the walls; the details differ from account to account, but they all point to the same fact: the fall of this city was bought with the lives of many men.
kits: 卡面這件配重投石車是本役真正吃重的一件器械。元軍在襄樊作戰時已經用過回回砲，那是一種以長臂配重把石彈甩出的攻城機，射程遠、砸力重，攻城者稱之為回回砲，宋人記其石彈重百五十斤，一發可中城樓；元廷在一二七五年把這套技術與工匠帶到川東，重慶城外的砲位就架在嘉陵江與長江交會處的灘地上，向城頭、譙樓與城垛逐日拋射。石料就地採集，機架由隨軍木匠豎起，砲位之間以土壘相隔，彈道全靠人工修正，正是卡面那句工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負的寫照。守方亦有同型器械，宋軍在城頭與江岸設置拋石機，稱飛石或砲車，一方面壓制元軍的攻城隊列與填壕工匠，另一方面把砲石甩向元軍營壘；元軍名將汪德臣正是被城頭拋石機的砲石擊中而重傷。除砲之外，元軍還備有鐵砲、震天雷一類火藥器械、雲梯、攻城車、搭在壕溝上的板木，以及繩索鉤援與渡江用的牛皮筏與木舟；宋軍則以神臂弓、床弩、弓弩、楯牌、拒馬、鐵蒺藜與礮石守城。運輸同樣是裝備的一部分：元軍的糧秣自北方經陸路與汴河運抵襄陽、荊州一線，再由船隻溯長江轉入嘉陵江，每一段轉運都要折損；宋軍的糧道則自成都沿沱江、瀘州而下，一條路被切斷，城內的存糧就開始計日。因此在這場戰爭裡，配重投石車與糧秣其實是同一件東西的兩半：砲決定守軍能不能露頭，糧道決定守軍能不能一直不露頭。
kitsEn: The trebuchet on the card was the instrument that really bore the weight of this siege. The Yuan had already used the huihui pao at Xiangyang, a siege engine that flung its stone shot from a long arm by counterweight, with long range and heavy impact; the besiegers called it the Muslim trebuchet, and the Song recorded that its shot weighed a hundred and fifty jin and could strike a tower with a single throw. The Yuan court brought that technology and those crews to eastern Sichuan in 1275, and the artillery positions outside Chongqing were set up on the flats where the Jialing meets the Yangtze, throwing at the parapets, the towers and the gates of the city day after day. The stone was quarried on the spot, the frames were raised by the army's own carpenters, the positions were separated by earthen banks, and the aim was corrected by hand; this is exactly what the card says, that engineering settles a siege before the weapons do. The defenders had a machine of the same kind: the Song set up trebuchets on the walls and along the river, called flying stones or pao carts, which suppressed the Yuan assault columns and the teams filling the moat, and at the same time hurled their own shot back at the Mongol camp. It was a stone from one of these wall trebuchets that struck Wang Dechen and put him out of action. Beside the artillery the Yuan brought iron bombards, explosive shells of the thunder-crash type, scaling ladders, siege towers, timber laid across the moat, grappling ropes for hooking the walls, and hide-and-timber rafts and boats for crossing the river. The Song answered with the divine arm bow, the bed crossbow, ordinary bows and crossbows, shields, caltrops, wooden stakes and stones for slinging. Transport was part of the equipment as well: the Yuan grain came overland from the north and by water up the Bian canal as far as Xiangyang and Jingzhou, then by boat up the Yangtze and into the Jialing, losing at every transhipment; the Song supply line ran down from Chengdu along the Tuo and past Luzhou, and once that one road was cut the grain inside the walls began to be counted by days. In this war the trebuchet and the grain were in effect two halves of one thing: the artillery decided whether the defenders could show their heads, and the supply line decided whether they could go on not showing them.
tactics: 元軍的攻城辦法是一套典型的圍城工程序列：先以輕騎分兵封鎖由成都經瀘州到重慶的糧道與各條出川通道，隔絕外援，再在城外選擇背靠山岡、面臨江灘的高處築壘扎營，把營寨與砲位安插在能俯瞰城頭的地勢上，然後用配重投石車日夜覆蓋城頭，逼迫守軍縮在城垛之下不敢露頭；與此同時工匠在壕溝上架板、填土、堆壘，把城外的空地一段段填平，逼守軍把注意力從砲火轉向地面的連續進攻。宋軍在江面另設攔江障礙與浮梁，用水勢與木柵阻止元軍船隻溯江直抵城下。元軍的辦法是從上游另找出路，在江面架設索橋、把舟筏牽過金湯江一帶的險段，繞開宋軍的攔江線，再以輕舟分隊夜渡，尋找城防空隙。守方的反擊以砲火與夜襲為主：張珏與部將多次在夜裡出城，襲擊元軍的砲位與營壘，把剛架好的攻城器物拆毀或燒掉；重慶守軍也曾靠城頭拋石機的齊射壓住元軍的進攻梯隊，迫使元軍一次次退回原路。合州釣魚城的守將王堅更在一二五九年率敢死隊夜襲蒙哥汗的中軍，蒙古軍一時大潰，蒙哥汗本人亦死於軍中，一說即受宋軍砲石所傷，這是配重投石車在宋元戰爭中第一次被記錄下可能決定一位大汗性命的武器。圍城之後的勝負手在糧道：宋廷屢次派兵出川東與瀘州方向解圍，援軍或被元軍擊退，或被擱在半路，城中存糧耗盡，守軍無法再支持，開城投降才成為最後的選擇。
tacticsEn: The Yuan method of assault followed a standard siege-engineering sequence. Light cavalry were first sent out in detachments to seal the supply road running from Chengdu through Luzhou to Chongqing and every route out of Sichuan, cutting the city off from relief; then the army chose high ground outside the walls, backs against the ridges and facing the river flats, raised camp and earthworks there, and placed the camps and the artillery positions where they could look down on the parapets; the trebuchets then covered the walls day and night, pressing the defenders to keep their heads below the crenellations. At the same time the craftsmen laid planks, filled earth and piled up brush across the ditch, filling the open ground outside the city strip by strip and forcing the defenders to shift their attention from the artillery fire to the continuous pressure on the ground. The Song blocked the river with barriers and floating beams, using the current and timber fences to keep Yuan boats from coming up directly to the foot of the walls. The Yuan answer was to find another way round from upstream: they threw a rope bridge across the river above the city and hauled boats and rafts past the dangerous stretch of the Jintang River, slipping behind the Song's river line, and then divided their light boats into night crossings to look for gaps in the defences. The defenders answered with artillery fire and night sorties: Zhang Jue and his men went out of the city more than once by night to attack the Yuan artillery positions and camp and to break up or burn the siege engines that had just been raised; the garrison of Chongqing also used massed shots from the wall trebuchets to hold back the Yuan assault ladders and drive them back the way they had come. At Diaoyucheng in Hezhou, Wang Jian had already gone further in 1259, leading a band of dare-to-die men in a night attack on the centre of Mongke Khan's army, which scattered the Mongol lines and killed Mongke himself, in one account from a stone thrown by a Song catapult. This was the first time in the Song-Yuan wars that a counterweight trebuchet was recorded as having possibly decided the life of a Great Khan. Once the siege was drawn out, the decisive factor was the supply road: the Song court repeatedly sent armies out towards eastern Sichuan and Luzhou to relieve the city, and the relief forces were either beaten back or cut off on the way, the grain inside the walls ran out, and the garrison could hold on no longer, which is why surrender became the only option left at the end.
data: 可以核對的數字大致如下。這場圍城自元至元十二年秋（一二七五年，據元代諸史所載汪德臣陣亡於此役之秋）開始，至至元十四年（一二七七年）重慶城陷，前後一年有餘，攻城季節集中在秋冬。負責圍城的元軍戰兵以萬計，若連同隨軍工匠、運夫與沿途徵發的人力，總數遠高於此，但元代文獻多不載確數；南宋守重慶的部隊則以數千計，張珏、趙安等名下各領數千至數萬不等，各說互有出入。器械方面，宋人記元軍回回砲所發石彈重百五十斤，遠可及數百步，此數出自襄樊之役的記載，重慶所用與之相類；宋軍城頭拋石機射程稍短，但居高臨下，恰好落在元軍營壘與攻城器械之上，這也是守方能傷到主將的關鍵。距離方面，重慶府城距大都數千里，自荊湖前沿溯江而上約千餘里；糧秣自北方運來，先走陸路至襄陽、汴梁一線，再由船隻溯長江轉入嘉陵江，一路上轉運的遞減極大。另有兩個可對照的數字：襄樊之戰自一二六七年圍到一二七三年，凡六年，回回砲首度大規模用於攻城；重慶之戰則是同一批技術與同一批工匠的第二次大規模運用。比較兩役可見，砲力決定城頭的處境，封鎖與糧道決定城的歸屬，而重慶兩樣都輸了。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. The siege opened in the autumn of the twelfth year of Zhixuan (1275, the year in which the Yuan records place the death of Wang Dechen in this campaign) and Chongqing fell in the fourteenth year (1277), so it ran for rather more than a year, with the fighting concentrated in the autumn and winter. The Yuan combat troops committed to the siege numbered in the tens of thousands; counting the craftsmen, the porters and the labour levied along the route the total was far higher, but the Yuan literature rarely gives exact figures. The Song garrison of Chongqing was counted in thousands, with several thousand or several tens of thousands attributed to commanders such as Zhang Jue and Zhao An, and the accounts differ from one to the next. On equipment: the Song recorded that the stone shot of the Yuan huihui pao weighed a hundred and fifty jin and carried several hundred paces, a figure that comes from the siege of Xiangyang and that the machines at Chongqing presumably matched. The wall trebuchets of the Song had a shorter range but looked down from above onto exactly the Mongol camp and siege works, and that was why a commander of rank could be hit there. On distance: the prefecture city of Chongqing lies several thousand li from Dadu, and about a thousand li or more up the river from the Jinghu front; the grain came from the north by land to the Xiangyang and Bianliang line and was then transferred by boat up the Yangtze and into the Jialing, shrinking badly at every transhipment. Two further figures allow comparison: Xiangyang was besieged from 1267 to 1273, six years in all, and was the first great use of the huihui pao against a Chinese city; Chongqing was the second large-scale employment of the same technique and the same craftsmen. Set the two side by side and it is clear that artillery decided the condition of the parapets, while blockade and the supply line decided to whom the city belonged, and at Chongqing the city lost on both counts.
cause: 這場圍城有四層原因疊在一起。第一層是忽必烈的一貫目標：滅宋、統一中原與江南，自一二六〇年代起即在四川、江淮、荊湖三面用兵，一二七三年襄樊陷落、一二七五年鄂州被圍、元軍進逼臨安之後，統一只差四川這塊硬骨頭。第二層是宋廷自己的失誤：丞相賈似道在鄂州一線主持的和解被朝廷推翻，元軍使者被殺，和議作廢，忽必烈隨即下詔令各路大軍全線進攻，川東圍城就是在這道詔令下開始的。第三層是地形與守禦的取捨：南宋把最後的兵力與糧秣押在四川的山城體系上，重慶倚山帶江、三面環水，城門少而險要，只要守得住就能拖住元軍；王堅接手之後修城儲糧、添設砲位，把重慶經營成一座真正的要塞，這是一套以時間換空間、以糧草換生命的防禦思路。第四層是技術的成熟：元廷自襄樊一役得到了配重投石車的技術與一批回回砲手，滅宋的工程能力已經具備，重慶的城牆再厚，也擋不住石彈一日數十發的覆蓋。城牆靠砲與糧，攻城靠的是把這兩樣東西同時壓到守軍頭上，而重慶的守軍兩樣都缺。
causeEn: Four causes lie one on top of another in this siege. The first is Kublai Khan's standing objective: the destruction of the Song and the unification of the central plains and the south. He had been campaigning against Sichuan, Jianghuai and Jinghu since the 1260s, and after the fall of Xiangyang in 1273, the investment of Ezhou in 1275 and the advance of the Yuan army towards Lin'an, only the hard core of Sichuan stood between him and a unified empire. The second cause was a mistake by the Song court itself: the settlement negotiated on the Ezhou front by the chancellor Jia Sidao was overturned by the court, the Yuan emissaries were killed, the agreement was void, and Kublai at once issued orders for a general offensive on every front, and the investment of Chongqing began under that order. The third cause was a choice about terrain and defence: the Song had committed its last troops and its last grain to the mountain-fortress system of Sichuan, and Chongqing, built against the hills and girdled by the river, with few gates and all of them dangerous, could hold off the Yuan for as long as it was supplied. Wang Jian repaired the walls, stored grain and added artillery positions, turning Chongqing into a real fortress; the logic was to trade space for time and grain for life. The fourth cause was the maturity of the engineering. From the siege of Xiangyang the Yuan court had gained both the technique of the counterweight trebuchet and a corps of Huihui artillerymen, and the engineering capacity to destroy the Song was already in hand. No matter how thick the walls of Chongqing, they could not stand against tens of stone shots a day. Walls answer to artillery and to grain, and siege is the business of pressing both onto the defender at once; at Chongqing the defenders lacked both.
impact: 重慶陷落是宋元戰爭的轉折點之一。四川的山城體系自此崩解：重慶失守之後，瀘州、夔州方向的據點相繼淪陷，元軍取得長江上游的控制，舟師可以自重慶、瀆州直下江陵、鄂州，與伯顏在荊湖的部隊接成一片，江南再無成片的可守之地；一二七六年臨安出降，一二七九年崖山失守，南宋覆亡。從技術史的角度看，這一役是配重投石車在中國攻城史上最集中的一次演出：砲的威力、封鎖的效率、工匠與糧秣的組織，被完整地搬到一座真正的山城面前，結果仍然要靠斷糧與封鎖收尾，這一點對後來蒙古人攻打其他山城、以及元代之後中原對攻城砲的重視，都有直接影響。在人物與記憶的層面，王堅與張珏成為抗元守土的象徵，張珏自重慶被俘至大都，備受威逼而不降，一二七八年被殺，他的名字與重慶、釣魚城一起留在後世詩文與地方記憶之中；重慶的城樓、江上的砲位與獨釣中原的意象，後來長期是中國人講述山城防禦的樣本。元軍的攻守也留下一條冷峻的教訓：攻城方要在堅城前折損名將、耗掉大量時間，代價極高，蒙古統治者此後更倚重封鎖、招降與水陸控制，而不是硬撞城牆；這條教訓在往後的西南與西北征伐中一再被用到。
impactEn: The fall of Chongqing was one of the turning points of the Song-Yuan war. The mountain-fortress system of Sichuan came apart: with Chongqing lost, the strongholds towards Luzhou and Kuizhou surrendered in turn, the Yuan took control of the upper Yangtze, and its flotilla could run down from Chongqing and Luzhou to Jiangling and Ezhou and join hands with Bayan's army in Jinghu, leaving the south without any coherent defensible territory. Lin'an surrendered in 1276, Yashan fell in 1279, and the Song was extinguished. From the point of view of technical history this campaign was the most concentrated performance the counterweight trebuchet ever gave in the history of Chinese siege warfare: the power of the artillery, the efficiency of the blockade and the organisation of craftsmen and grain were brought in full against a genuine mountain city, and it still ended by cutting the food supply and sealing the roads. That lesson told directly on how the Mongols attacked other mountain cities afterwards, and on how seriously the central plains took siege artillery from the Yuan period onward. At the level of people and memory, Wang Jian and Zhang Jue became the images of a land that held out: Zhang Jue was carried from Chongqing to Dadu, put to every kind of pressure, refused to submit, and was killed in 1278, and his name has stayed with Chongqing and Diaoyucheng in later poetry and local memory. The towers of Chongqing, the artillery positions on the river and the image of a single man fishing alone in the middle of the realm long remained the Chinese way of talking about defence in mountain cities. The Yuan side of the story left a colder lesson: the besieger lost a famous general and months of effort against a stubborn city, and the Mongol rulers afterwards relied far more on blockade, on inducing surrender and on control of the rivers and roads than on hurling themselves against walls, a lesson applied again and again in the campaigns to the south-west and the north-west.
result: 直接結果是重慶的陷落。一二七七年，城中存糧耗盡、援兵無望，宋廷下令議降，張珏率部出城突圍，兵敗被俘，重慶守軍分批解送北方，王堅在此之前已被召回貶官、死於赴闕途中，元軍在城內接管了重慶路的軍政，後以汪良臣總領此地，設重慶路總管府，把四川東部的統治從軍事佔領轉為常設的行政機構。技術層面的結果則是雙向的：一方面，配重投石車完成了它在宋元戰爭中最後一次大規模運用，證明砲火能壓制城頭、能封鎖城門，卻不能單獨決定一座山城的存亡，糧道與封鎖才是真正的攻城武器；另一方面，元軍自重慶順江而下，一二七八年夔州失守，一二七九年宋室於崖山覆滅，元朝完成統一，長江流域自此歸於一朝。回頭看，這場戰爭的勝負並不是在投石車與城牆之間決出的，而是在配重投石車與糧秣之間決出的：砲把守軍釘在城頭上，斷糧把守軍釘死在城裡，最後開城的一刻，靠的是後方而不是射擊。
resultEn: The immediate result was the fall of Chongqing. In 1277 the grain inside the walls was exhausted and no relief was coming, the Song court authorised terms of surrender, Zhang Jue led a breakout, was beaten and taken, and the garrison of Chongqing was marched north in batches; Wang Jian had already been recalled and stripped of his command and died on the road to the capital, and the Yuan took over the military government of the prefecture, later entrusting the region to Wang Liangchen and establishing a permanent administrative office for the circuit of Chongqing, so that the rule over eastern Sichuan passed from military occupation to regular administration. The technical result runs in both directions. On one side the counterweight trebuchet completed the last of its great uses in the Song-Yuan wars, and demonstrated that artillery could pin the parapets and seal the gates but could not by itself decide the fate of a mountain city: the supply line and the blockade were the real weapons of siege. On the other side the Yuan army ran down the river from Chongqing, Kuizhou fell in 1278, the Song house was destroyed at Yashan in 1279, and the Yuan completed the unification of the country and the Yangtze basin under a single dynasty. Looked at afterwards, this war was not decided between the trebuchet and the wall, but between the trebuchet and the grain: the artillery nailed the defenders to the parapets, the cutoff nailed them inside the city, and the moment the gates opened was decided by the rear and not by the shooting.
